{'0': 'The mega streaming merger between HBO Max and Paramount+ may not actually be happening.'}

{'1': 'The deal was announced back in March after Netflix dropped its bid to take over Warner Bros. Discovery. However, a federal judge has now issued a temporary injunction blocking the deal — at least for now…'}

{'2': 'The planned merger'}

{'3': 'Paramount was set to acquire Warner Bros. Discovery, combining their streaming services HBO Max and Paramount+ into a single offering.'}

{'4': 'The temporary injunction'}

{'5': "Viewers weren't exactly thrilled about this plan, fearing less competition would result in higher prices. A coalition of 12 state attorneys general shared that sentiment and asked a federal court to issue a temporary injunction to block the deal. According to NBC News, that injunction has now been granted."}

{'6': 'The injunction will last for 14 days, during which a hearing will be held. And even if Paramount wins out eventually, the merger is being reviewed by the EU and UK governments. Meanwhile, the Writers Guild of America has also filed an antitrust lawsuit, citing job losses and reduced pay.'}
